name: Udyam Registration
summary: Free official MSME registration. No money attached, but it is the identity almost every MSME scheme, subsidy and priority-sector lending benefit is keyed to, so it is the cheapest high-value action an unregistered enterprise can take.
administering_ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: No cash benefit. Establishes micro, small or medium classification, which is a precondition for CGTMSE, ZED, public procurement preference and delayed-payment protection.

criteria.description: The enterprise must not already hold an Udyam registration.
Turnover must be within the medium enterprise ceiling for the enterprise to be classifiable as an MSME.
The enterprise must be engaged in manufacturing or providing services, and must hold a PAN. Registration is self-declared but validated against PAN and GSTIN records.

document_requirements.document_name: Aadhaar of the proprietor, partner or authorised signatory
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Existing Aadhaar is used. It must be linked to a working mobile number for OTP verification.
Apply online through the Income Tax e-filing portal or NSDL if the entity does not hold one.

windows.notes: Always open, free of charge. Any site charging a fee for Udyam registration is not the official portal.

benefits.description: Udyam registration number and certificate, establishing MSME classification.
benefits.conditions_for_disbursement: Issued immediately on successful self-declaration. Classification is revised automatically as turnover and investment data change.
